extracted.name: Candied Kielbasa
extracted.description: Slow cooking brings out the spicy sweetness of this Kielbasa dish--made zesty with ketchup, horseradish, and brown sugar.
instruction_lines: In a slow cooker combine the sugar, ketchup and horseradish. Add the sausage, and mix well. Cook on High until it starts to boil. Reduce heat to Low, and cook until sauce thickens, about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
